correctness.rationale: Reindexing the coordinates along the \(\gcd(n,v)\) cycles turns the first named family exactly into a Cartesian product of ordinary odd-length chi blocks. Reversal plus complement conjugates the second family blockwise to the same product. Direct-product identities then give the order, inverse degree, Kronecker-factorized differential distribution, differential uniformity, and permanent absence of cross-track diffusion. The inspected finite verifier confirms these identities for representative valid sizes, but the proof is algebraic and does not depend on the finite cases.
residual_risks: The finite verifier is corroboration only; it is not used as an exhaustive proof.
